feedback_outputs.source:
But despite his hard words, his eyes settle on yours. Studying. Deciding. His mouth settles into an irritated line.  

"Look," he says, running a hand over his stubbled scalp. "You hide it well, but I can tell you're new here. I ent trying to offend you, but I... don't like leaving folk new to Sagus on their own. If you have questions about the city - or Circus Minor in particular - I'll answer 'em, free of charge."
feedback_outputs.translation:
但尽管他话说得硬，他的目光却落在你身上。端详。斟酌。他的嘴抿成一条烦躁的直线。  

“听着，”他说，一只手抚过自己覆着短发茬的头皮。“你掩饰得很好，但我看得出来你是新来的。我不是想冒犯你，只是我……不喜欢让初到萨古斯的人独自待着。如果你对这座城市——或者尤其是小竞技场——有什么问题，我会回答，不收钱。”

feedback_outputs.source:
He stares at her, chewing his lip, clearly trying to work up the courage to talk to her... to convince her of something. Finally, with a wry twist of his mouth, he turns back at you. 

"Look," he says, running a hand over his stubbled scalp. "You hide it well, but I can tell you're new here. I ent trying to offend you, but I... don't like leaving folk new to Sagus on their own. If you have questions about the city - or Circus Minor in particular - I'll answer 'em, free of charge."
feedback_outputs.translation:
他盯着她，咬着嘴唇，显然正努力鼓起勇气跟她说话……想说服她什么。最后，他嘴角一歪，露出苦笑，重新转向你。

“听着，”他说着，用手抚过自己覆着短发茬的头皮，“你掩饰得很好，但我看得出你是新来的。我不是想冒犯你，只是我……不喜欢把初到萨古斯的人丢下不管。如果你对这座城市——尤其是小竞技场——有什么疑问，我会免费回答。”

feedback_outputs.source: A set of bonuses granted by the Hardened descriptor.
feedback_outputs.translation: 由“坚韧”描述符提供的一组加成。

feedback_outputs.source: Heavy and solid, this brown orb feels like a rock that has been worn smooth by a constant flow of water. On one side, there's an indentation that just fits a human hand. When activated, the bounder absorbs the user and teleports them to a nearby location within line of sight.
feedback_outputs.translation: 这枚棕色光球沉重而坚实，摸起来像一块被持续水流磨得光滑的石头。它的一侧有一处恰好贴合人类手掌的凹痕。激活后，跃迁会吸收使用者，并将其传送到视线范围内的一处附近地点。
